heading.en: Join at the back, leave from the front

hook.en: A queue has two main moves: ENQUEUE, when someone joins at the back, and DEQUEUE, when the person at the front is served.
hook.kn: ಕ್ಯೂನಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಮುಖ್ಯ ಚಲನೆಗಳು: ENQUEUE (ಹಿಂದೆ ಸೇರುವುದು) ಮತ್ತು DEQUEUE (ಮುಂದಿನವರು ಹೊರಡುವುದು).

objectives.en: Use IS EMPTY, PEEK and IS FULL
Explain overflow and underflow in a queue

narration.en: A queue has two main moves: ENQUEUE, when someone joins at the back, and DEQUEUE, when the person at the front is served.
narration.kn: ಕ್ಯೂನಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಮುಖ್ಯ ಚಲನೆಗಳು: ENQUEUE (ಹಿಂದೆ ಸೇರುವುದು) ಮತ್ತು DEQUEUE (ಮುಂದಿನವರು ಹೊರಡುವುದು).

body.en: ENQUEUE inserts a new element at the REAR; inserting into a full queue gives overflow. DEQUEUE removes the element at the FRONT; removing from an empty queue gives underflow. IS EMPTY checks whether the queue has any element, to avoid underflow. PEEK returns the FRONT element without removing it. IS FULL checks whether more elements can be added, to avoid overflow.

narration.en: ENQUEUE inserts a new element at the REAR; inserting into a full queue gives overflow. DEQUEUE removes the element at the FRONT; removing from an empty queue gives underflow. IS EMPTY checks whether the queue has any element, to avoid underflow. PEEK returns the FRONT element without removing it. IS FULL checks whether more elements can be added, to avoid overflow.
narration.kn: ENQUEUE REAR ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ತುಂಬಿದ ಕ್ಯೂನಲ್ಲಿ ಓವರ್‌ಫ್ಲೋ. DEQUEUE FRONT ಅಂಶ ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಖಾಲಿ ಕ್ಯೂನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂಡರ್‌ಫ್ಲೋ. IS EMPTY, PEEK, IS FULL ಸಹಾಯಕ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು.

title.en: On the board: Tracing queue operations

say.en: Start with an empty queue and enqueue 5, then 8, then 3.
DEQUEUE removes and returns the front element, 5.
Enqueue 9 joins at the rear. PEEK shows the front, 8, without removing it.
Before dequeuing, check isEmpty. Dequeuing from an empty queue is underflow; adding to a full queue is overflow.

narration.en: We trace a sequence of ENQUEUE, DEQUEUE and PEEK operations and meet underflow.

caption.en: Watch ENQUEUE add at the rear and DEQUEUE remove from the front.

tryThis.en: Enqueue three values and note which one is at the FRONT.
Dequeue until the queue is empty, then try once more.

narration.en: Watch ENQUEUE add at the rear and DEQUEUE remove from the front. Enqueue three values and note which one is at the FRONT. Dequeue until the queue is empty, then try once more.

title.en: Count the elements in a queue

caption.en: After n enqueues and d dequeues on an empty queue, the queue holds n − d elements. The front is the (d + 1)-th element that was added.

label.en: Elements in the queue n − d

tryThis.en: Make d larger than n: what does a negative size mean? (underflow)
Make n − d larger than N: what happens? (overflow)
Enqueue 4 and dequeue 1: which element is at the front?

narration.en: After n enqueues and d dequeues on an empty queue, the queue holds n − d elements. The front is the (d + 1)-th element that was added. Make d larger than n: what does a negative size mean? (underflow)

problem.en: Starting with an empty queue: ENQUEUE A, ENQUEUE B, DEQUEUE, ENQUEUE C, PEEK, ENQUEUE D, DEQUEUE. Show the queue after each step and the value returned by PEEK.

steps.en: ENQUEUE C → [B, C]; PEEK returns B (queue unchanged)
ENQUEUE D → [B, C, D]; DEQUEUE → B leaves → [C, D]

answer.en: PEEK returned B; final queue (FRONT to REAR): C, D

narration.en: Trace each operation. PEEK only looks, it does not remove.

narration.en: Recap. ENQUEUE adds at the REAR; DEQUEUE removes from the FRONT. Overflow: enqueue into a full queue. Underflow: dequeue from an empty queue. PEEK looks at the FRONT without removing it.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ENQUEUE REAR ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; DEQUEUE FRONT ನಿಂದ ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಓವರ್‌ಫ್ಲೋ: ತುಂಬಿದ ಕ್ಯೂಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸುವುದು. ಅಂಡರ್‌ಫ್ಲೋ: ಖಾಲಿ ಕ್ಯೂನಿಂದ ತೆಗೆಯುವುದು. PEEK FRONT ಅಂಶವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆಯದೆ ನೋಡುತ್ತದೆ.
